images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 20th Century

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame (an industrial card, 1930s): a row of one-storey frame shops and offices with stepped false fronts and plain windows, a stack and a taller brick plant behind; 1930s cars parked on a dirt shoulder

why.note: the small works next to the big plant: cheap frame buildings on the street line
